page_title: LYO 1-4 PSG | Lyon v PSG 03/09/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+4' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+1' Kylian Mbappe (Paris SG) drives into the box and hits a tremendous shot that, unluckily for him, flashes just wide of the left post.
90' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.
88' Jeffinho (Lyon) latches onto the ball after a scramble in the box, but his placed effort towards the bottom right corner is far too weak and Gianluigi Donnarumma makes a simple save.
86' It will be a substitution. Cher Ndour (Paris SG) is ready to enter the pitch as Warren Zaire-Emery walks off.
86' Bradley Barcola (Paris SG) receives a precise pass inside the box and takes a shot that flies just wide of the right post.
84' Paris SG keep possession of the ball with some short passes, waiting for the moment to hit the opposition swiftly on the break.
80' Laurent Blanc has decided to substitute Corentin Tolisso and he is replaced by Johann Lepenant (Lyon).

78' A sweeping move ends with a pass to Goncalo Ramos (Paris SG) inside the box. He lets fly towards the bottom right corner, but Anthony Lopes was watching it all the way and makes a comfortable save.
76' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Manuel Ugarte leaves the pitch and Fabian Ruiz (Paris SG) comes on.
76' Substitution. Rayan Cherki will be replaced by Skelly Alvero (Lyon).
76' The substitution has been made. Jeffinho (Lyon) has replaced Ernest Nuamah.
75' Luis Enrique has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Goncalo Ramos (Paris SG) replacing Marco Asensio.
75' Here comes a substitution. Bradley Barcola (Paris SG) is brought on as a substitute for Ousmane Dembele.
74' 1 - 4 GOAL! That’s a great strike from the spot by Corentin Tolisso (Lyon) into the right of the net, giving goalkeeper Gianluigi Donnarumma no chance!
74' Corentin Tolisso (Lyon) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
73' Warren Zaire-Emery (Paris SG) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Eric Wattellier had an easy-decision to make.
73' Here comes the VAR decision. YES, it's a penalty!

72' Play continues despite the shouts by some Lyon players for a penalty. Wait! Referee Eric Wattellier interrupts the game right now and he will review that decision using VAR! Let's see what happens.
71' One of the Lyon players is in on goal but gets upended by the defender in the box. That could be a penalty, but the ref says NO! Play continues.
71' Ernest Nuamah (Lyon) wins himself just enough space inside the box to connect with the corner. His header flies towards the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper blocks the effort.
70' Maxence Caqueret (Lyon) will deliver the corner kick.
69' Total attempts – 14:17. 5:7 - the latest stats for both teams in respect of shots on target.
65' Ousmane Dembele (Paris SG) lets fly with a decent effort from the edge of the box that flashes just wide of the right post.
64' Ernest Nuamah (Lyon) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
63' Ousmane Dembele (Paris SG) looks like he will be the one to take the corner kick.

63' Warren Zaire-Emery (Paris SG) releases a low pass from just outside the box in an attempt to find his teammate, but one of the defenders calmly averts the threat. The ball goes out for a corner. Paris SG can continue in their attacking effort.
59' The keeper doesn't have to worry about this one. Marco Asensio (Paris SG) sacrificed accuracy for power, and thus his attempt went well over the bar.
58' Ainsley Maitland-Niles (Lyon) receives a yellow card for infringement.
57' Ousmane Dembele (Paris SG) makes a good run with the ball into the box, but mishits his shot as it goes high over the bar.
57' Ernest Nuamah (Lyon) weaves his way through the defence and gets within shooting range inside the box, but his effort to the right post is thwarted by Gianluigi Donnarumma.
56' Ousmane Dembele (Paris SG) latches on to a superb cross inside the box but only hits the crossbar with a fine header. What a chance!

53' Vitinha (Paris SG) gets on the end of a pass on the edge of the penalty area and shoots towards the middle of the goal. He didn't put enough power into the effort, though, and Anthony Lopes pulls off an easy save.
53' Paris SG take a short corner kick.
53' A pass lands at the feet of Kylian Mbappe (Paris SG) in the middle of the box, he looks up and shoots but the effort is superbly blocked by a defender.

49' Corentin Tolisso (Lyon) takes the resulting free kick from outside the box. He sends a nice cross into the box, but his intention is well anticipated by the goalkeeper who comes out to collect the ball.
48' That will be a yellow card for one of the players. The one who gets booked is Lucas Hernandez (Paris SG).
48' Kylian Mbappe (Paris SG) finds himself in an offside position and the referee stops play after the linesman raises his flag.

46' Ernest Nuamah (Lyon) was in a good shooting position inside the six-yard box and produced a first-time shot towards the bottom right corner, but the goalkeeper made an astonishing save to thwart him.
46' The game is over for Tino Kadewere (Lyon). Mama Balde comes on for the second half.
46' Referee Eric Wattellier blows his whistle to start the second half.
45+3' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+1' 0 - 4 Kylian Mbappe (Paris SG) collects a killer pass inside the box that puts him one-on-one against the goalkeeper. He scores, drilling a low drive deep inside the left post!

45+1' Chance! Corentin Tolisso (Lyon) gets to the rebound on the edge of the box and smashes the ball towards the bottom left corner, but Gianluigi Donnarumma is alert and makes a great save to deny him.
45' We will have 2 min. of added time.
44' Maxence Caqueret floats over the corner and Sinaly Diomande (Lyon) gets on the end of it, but his header from around the penalty spot sails well wide of the right post.
44' Maxence Caqueret (Lyon) will deliver the ball into the penalty box from a corner kick.
43' Kylian Mbappe (Paris SG) is first to react to a loose pass inside the box, but slices his shot just wide of the right post.
41' That's a well-taken pass by Rayan Cherki (Lyon). He unleashes a strike from the edge of the box, but blazes it high over the bar.
40' Maxence Caqueret (Lyon) has a go from a long way out but it sails way over.

38' 0 - 3 Goal! Manuel Ugarte displays great vision and sends a pass to Marco Asensio (Paris SG), who shows brilliant composure inside the box to bury the ball into the top of the net. The score is 0:3.
38' The current number of shots on target for both teams is 6:6. The current number of shots on goal is 2:3.
34' Corentin Tolisso (Lyon) meets the lofted pass inside the box with a well placed shot towards the bottom left corner, but Gianluigi Donnarumma pulls off a fantastic save to deny him.
32' Achraf Hakimi (Paris SG) expertly controls a neat clever pass inside the box, but his effort crashes against the crossbar! What an opportunity that was!
32' Lyon have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.

31' Rayan Cherki (Lyon) connected with a pass around the edge of the box, aimed and shot. His attempt went towards the top right corner, but Gianluigi Donnarumma was alert and the score remains the same. The ball is out of play. Lyon will have a chance to score from a corner.
30' Close! Duje Caleta-Car (Lyon) picks up the ball in space and from inside the penalty area sends a shot inches wide of the left post.
30' Lyon work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
26' Maxence Caqueret (Lyon) swings in the corner, but the goalkeeper does a brilliant job to intercept the effort.
23' Vitinha (Paris SG) finds his teammate inside the box with a sweet pass. However, Marco Asensio wasn't able to finish and lost the ball.
20' 0 - 2 Goal! 0:2. Achraf Hakimi (Paris SG) taps home from almost on the goal line after a lucky rebound fell at his feet.

20' Ousmane Dembele (Paris SG) receives a precise pass and is given time inside the box to send a promising strike towards the bottom left corner. Anthony Lopes guesses his intention and denies him with a fine save.
19' This shall not pass! Vitinha (Paris SG) lines up a shot from the edge of the box and goes for goal, but the effort is well blocked by a defender.
17' Marquinhos (Paris SG) plays a long ball to Kylian Mbappe, but the defence is well organised and manages to get it clear.

16' Vitinha (Paris SG) receives a precise low pass inside the box, controls the ball and releases it towards the top left corner. Unfortunately for him, Anthony Lopes makes a great save to stop his effort.
15' Paris SG hold the ball and display nice passing from player to player.
13' Ernest Nuamah (Lyon) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat.

12' Rayan Cherki (Lyon) weaves through the defence with ease and gets into a good position in front of goal. He pulls the trigger in an effort to beat the keeper, but fails as the ball zooms around the right post.
9' Ousmane Dembele (Paris SG) tries to send the ball in front of the goal, but the opposition's defence averts the threat.
8' Tino Kadewere (Lyon) gets on the end of a pass on the edge of the box but his shot is blocked.
4' 0 - 1 Kylian Mbappe (Paris SG) sends Anthony Lopes the wrong way and fires the penalty into the middle of the goal!
4' Kylian Mbappe (Paris SG) is going to take the penalty!
3' Corentin Tolisso (Lyon) will have to be careful for the rest of the match as he is shown a yellow card.
3' Eric Wattellier blows his whistle for a foul after Corentin Tolisso (Lyon) hacks down one of his opponents. PENALTY to Paris SG!
1' The first half has just begun.
The players are on the pitch and Paris SG will have the kick-off.
Eric Wattellier was nominated as the referee for this game.
